n: Digital Technologies Hub Note the Music
t: A lesson idea that links music, code, and AI with LEGO, Google AI Duet, and Scratch.
steps: Open the lesson on the Digital Technologies Hub.
Gather LEGO bricks for the unplugged part.
Check that Google AI Duet is still available.
Open Scratch 3.0 and try the Music blocks.
Ask IT whether Google and Scratch are allowed.
Try the easy Scratch activity yourself.
Choose which levelled activities to assign.
